sloka: ततो मतिं राक्षसराजसूनुश्चकार तस्मिन् हरिवीरमुख्ये ।अवध्यतां तस्य कपेः समीक्ष्य कथं निगच्छेदिति निग्रहार्थम् ।। ५.४८.३६।।।।
transliteration: tato matiṁ rākṣasarājasūnuścakāra tasmin harivīramukhye ।avadhyatāṁ tasya kapeḥ samīkṣya kathaṁ nigacchediti nigrahārtham ।। 5.48.36।।।।

translations.english: Then the heroic master of weapons, an excellent and glorious warrior directed the Brahmastram towards the foremost of monkeys.
